section.content: 本发明涉及一种生物基因提取装置，包括柜体、安装于所述柜体内的离心组件、抽滤组件以及驱动组件，所述离心组件包括转动连接在所述柜体内的瓶体以及驱动所述瓶体转动进行离心工作的驱动件，所述瓶体的出液端内部安装有电磁阀门，所述抽滤组件包括抽滤瓶以及与所述抽滤瓶通过气管相连通进行抽滤工作的第一泵体，所述抽滤瓶的顶部内侧壁上转动连接有用于打开或关闭所述电磁阀门的接线柱；本发明通过在现有技术的基础上对离心组件和抽滤组件进行整合形成一体化结构，在使用过后中不需要人工参与便可以将离心内的沉淀移入抽滤瓶内进行抽滤，操作简单，省时省力，工作效率高。

The invention relates to a biological gene extraction device, which comprises a cabinet body, a centrifugal assembly, a suction filtration assembly and a driving assembly, wherein the centrifugal assembly is arranged in the cabinet body, the centrifugal assembly comprises a bottle body which is rotationally connected in the cabinet body and a driving piece which drives the bottle body to rotate for centrifugal operation, an electromagnetic valve is arranged in a liquid outlet end of the bottle body, the suction filtration assembly comprises a suction filtration bottle and a first pump body which is communicated with the suction filtration bottle through an air pipe for suction filtration operation, and a binding post which is used for opening or closing the electromagnetic valve is rotationally connected on the inner side wall of the top of the suction filtration bottle; according to the invention, the centrifugal assembly and the suction filtration assembly are integrated to form an integrated structure on the basis of the prior art, and after the centrifugal assembly and the suction filtration assembly are used, the sediment in the centrifugation can be moved into the suction filtration bottle for suction filtration without manual participation, so that the operation is simple, the time and the labor are saved, and the working efficiency is high.

Biological gene extraction deviceTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of gene extraction, in particular to a biological gene extraction device.

Background

Gene extraction is a common technical means in the biotechnology field, and the current gene extraction method comprises a CTAB method, a glass bead method, an ultrasonic method, a grinding method, a freeze thawing method, a guanidine isothiocyanate method, an alkaline cracking method, an enzyme method and the like, wherein the most common method is the CTAB method.

CTAB is a cationic detergent with the property of precipitating nucleic acids and acidic polysaccharides from low ionic strength solutions. In a solution with high ionic strength (> 0.7mol/L NaCl), CTAB forms a complex with protein and polysaccharide, but does not precipitate nucleic acid, and the nucleic acid can be separated out by adding ethanol for precipitation after removing impurities such as protein, polysaccharide, phenols and the like through extraction of an organic solvent. In the step of adding ethanol for precipitation, the supernatant after adding ethanol is required to be centrifuged by using a centrifugal device, the supernatant is taken out after centrifugation, and then the lower layer precipitate of the centrifuge tube is subjected to suction filtration by using a suction filtration device, so that the DAN with higher purity is obtained.

In the prior art, two devices are needed in the steps of centrifugation and suction filtration, and after centrifugation, sediment is manually transferred and suction filtered, so that the operation is troublesome, time and labor are wasted, and the working efficiency is low.

Therefore, there is a need to provide a new solution to overcome the above-mentioned drawbacks.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide a biological gene extraction device which can effectively solve the technical problems.

In order to achieve the purpose of the invention, the following technical scheme is adopted:

a biological gene extraction device comprising:

the cabinet body: the inside is provided with a baffle, and the middle part of the baffle is provided with a limiting hole;

Centrifugal assembly: comprising the following steps:

Bottle body: the electromagnetic valve is rotatably connected in the limiting hole, an electromagnetic valve is arranged in the liquid outlet end of the electromagnetic valve, the end part of the electromagnetic valve extends out of the bottle body, a mounting hole is formed in the end part of the electromagnetic valve, and a contact switch is arranged in the mounting hole;

and, a driving member: driving the bottle body to rotate for centrifugal work;

And (3) a suction filtration assembly: it comprises the following steps:

Suction filtration bottle: the top inner side wall is rotationally connected with a binding post, the top part of the binding post is inserted into the mounting hole, and in an initial state, the binding post is separated from the contact switch, and the contact switch is disconnected;

And, a first pump body: the suction bottle is communicated with the suction bottle through an air pipe to perform suction filtration;

And, a drive assembly: and driving the suction filtration assembly to move upwards or downwards so as to enable the binding post to be contacted with or disconnected from the contact switch, and then opening or closing the electromagnetic valve.

Further, the centrifugal assembly further comprises:

and (3) bottle cap: the liquid inlet of the bottle body is buckled in a sealing way;

And, driving the cylinder: the rotary frame is fixedly arranged on the inner side wall of the top of the cabinet body, and the end part of the driving end of the rotary frame is fixedly connected with the bottle cap in a rotary mode.

Further, the limiting hole is rotationally connected with the rotating disc, clamping grooves are uniformly distributed on the upper surface of the rotating disc along the circumferential direction of the rotating disc, positioning tables are fixedly arranged on the outer circumferential surface of the bottle body, positioning holes are formed in the surfaces of the positioning tables, annular flanges are fixedly arranged at the bottoms of the bottle caps, positioning columns are fixedly arranged on the lower surfaces of the annular flanges, and the positioning columns correspond to the positioning holes and the clamping grooves one by one.

Further, the driving member includes:

Ring gear: the middle part of the outer circumferential surface of the rotating disc is fixedly arranged;

Driving gear: the rotary connection is arranged in the partition board and meshed with the ring gear;

And, driving the motor: and the driving shaft penetrates through the partition plate and is fixedly connected with the driving gear, so that the driving gear is driven to drive the ring gear to rotate, and further the rotating disc and the bottle body are driven to rotate simultaneously to perform centrifugal operation.

Further, the suction filtration bottle comprises:

A suction filtration bottle body;

And (3) a filter frame: the filter plate is fixedly arranged in the suction bottle body;

and, end caps: the binding post is in rotary connection with the inner side wall of the end cover;

The suction filtration bottle body is communicated with the end cover and the filter frame, and the first pump body is communicated with the filter frame through an exhaust pipe.

Further, the driving assembly includes:

and (3) a hydraulic cylinder: the cabinet is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the cabinet body;

And, jacking the support: the suction bottle body is detachably connected with the jacking bracket, and the first pump body is fixedly connected with the jacking bracket.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial effects:

1. according to the invention, the centrifugal assembly and the suction filtration assembly are integrated to form an integrated structure on the basis of the prior art, and after the integrated structure is used, the sediment in the centrifugation can be moved into the suction filtration bottle for suction filtration without manual participation, so that the operation is simple, the time and the labor are saved, and the working efficiency is improved; and its simple structure, stability is high, and occupation space is less when using, also is convenient for deposit it when not using, easily uses widely.

2. The design scheme adopted by the invention is convenient for assembling or disassembling the whole machine, and when a certain part is damaged, the whole machine is convenient to replace or maintain without replacement, so that the use cost is greatly reduced.

Drawings

In order to more clearly illustrate the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present invention, the drawings that are required to be used in the description of the embodiments will be briefly described below.

FIG. 1 is a schematic diagram of a biological gene extraction device according to the present invention;

FIG. 2 is a schematic diagram showing the internal structure of a biological gene extraction device according to the present invention;

FIG. 3 is a schematic diagram showing a semi-sectional structure of a biological gene extraction device according to the present invention;

FIG. 4 is an exploded view showing the internal structure of a biological gene extraction device according to the present invention;

FIG. 5 is a schematic diagram showing the structure of the coupling between the centrifugal assembly and the driving member in the biological gene extraction device according to the present invention;

Fig. 6 is a schematic diagram of a mating connection structure of a centrifugal component and a suction filtration component in a biological gene extraction device according to the present invention.

Digital description in the drawings:

1. a cabinet body; 11. a partition plate; 12. a first operation chamber; 13. a second operation chamber;

2. A centrifuge assembly; 21. a bottle body; 22. a bottle cap; 23. a driving cylinder; 24. an electromagnetic valve; 25. a contact switch; 26. positioning holes; 27. positioning columns; 28. a rotating frame;

3. A suction filtration assembly; 31. a suction filtration bottle body; 32. a filter frame; 33. an end cap; 34. a filter plate; 35. binding posts; 36. a first pump body; 37. a second pump body; 38. a waste liquid collection box;

4. A drive assembly; 41. a hydraulic cylinder; 42. jacking the bracket;

5. A rotating disc; 6. a driving motor; 7. a drive gear; 8. a ring gear.

Detailed Description

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the embodiments of the present invention more apparent, the following description will be made in detail with reference to the technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is apparent that the described embodiments are some embodiments of the present invention, but not all embodiments.

In the description of the present invention, it should be understood that the terms "center," "lateral," "longitudinal," "front," "rear," "left," "right," "upper," "lower," "vertical," "horizontal," "top," "bottom," "inner," "outer," and the like indicate orientations or positional relationships based on the orientation or positional relationships shown in the drawings, merely to facilitate describing the present invention and simplify the description, and do not indicate or imply that the devices or elements referred to must have a specific orientation, be configured and operated in a specific orientation, and therefore should not be construed as limiting the scope of the present invention. When an element is referred to as being "fixed" to another element, it can be directly on the other element or intervening elements may also be present. When a component is considered to be "connected" to another component, it can be directly connected to the other component or intervening components may also be present. When an element is referred to as being "disposed on" another element, it can be directly on the other element or intervening elements may also be present. The terms "vertical," "horizontal," "left," "right," and the like are used herein for illustrative purposes only.

The biological gene extraction device according to the present invention will be described more fully below with reference to the accompanying drawings.

As shown in fig. 1 and 2, the present invention provides a biological gene extraction apparatus, which comprises a cabinet 1, a centrifugal assembly 2, a suction filtration assembly 3 and a driving assembly 4, wherein the centrifugal assembly 2, the suction filtration assembly 3 and the driving assembly 4 are installed in the cabinet 1.

Wherein, the cabinet body 1 is internally provided with a partition plate 11 which divides the cabinet body 1 into a first operation chamber 12 and a second operation chamber 13 which are distributed up and down.

The middle part of baffle 11 has been seted up spacing hole, the mounting chamber has been seted up to the lower surface of baffle 11, there is the shrouding outside of mounting chamber through bolted connection, the through-hole that is linked together with spacing hole has been seted up at the middle part of shrouding, the diameter of through-hole is less than the diameter of spacing hole.

The limiting hole is rotationally connected with a rotating disc 5, clamping grooves are uniformly distributed on the upper surface of the rotating disc 5 along the circumferential direction of the rotating disc, positioning ring blocks are fixedly arranged on the outer circumferential surface of the rotating disc 5, the cross sections of the positioning ring blocks are in a T shape, annular grooves are formed in the top of the mounting chamber and the upper surface of the sealing plate, and the positioning ring blocks are rotationally connected with the annular grooves, so that the stability of the rotating disc 5 in the rotating process can be improved.

The middle part of the outer circumferential surface of the positioning ring block is fixedly provided with a ring gear 8, a driving gear 7 is rotationally connected in the mounting chamber, the driving gear 7 is meshed and connected with the ring gear 8, a driving motor 6 is mounted on the upper surface of a partition plate 11, and a driving shaft of the driving motor 6 penetrates through the partition plate 11 and is fixedly connected with the driving gear 7 in a key connection mode. The driving motor 6 is used for driving the driving gear 7 to rotate so as to drive the rotating disc 5 to rotate. The ring gear 8, the driving gear 7 and the driving motor 6 form a driving member for driving the bottle body 21 to rotate.

As shown in fig. 3 to 5, the centrifugal assembly 2 includes a bottle body 21, a bottle cap 22, and a driving cylinder 23; the top of the bottle body 21 is provided with a liquid inlet, the bottom of the bottle body 21 is provided with a liquid outlet, an electromagnetic valve 24 is arranged at the liquid outlet, two ends of the electromagnetic valve 24 extend out of the tube body of the bottle body 21, a contact switch 25 is arranged at the end of the electromagnetic valve, a sealing ring is arranged at the position where a rotating shaft of the electromagnetic valve 24 contacts with the bottle body 21, and the rotating shaft is rotationally connected with the sealing ring.

In addition, a positioning table is arranged at one end, close to the liquid inlet, of the outer circumferential surface of the bottle body 21, and positioning holes 26 corresponding to the clamping grooves on the rotating disc 5 are uniformly distributed on the surface of the positioning table; the bottle cap 22 is buckled at the top of the bottle body 21, an annular flange is arranged at the bottom of the bottle cap 22, positioning columns 27 are uniformly distributed on the bottom surface of the annular flange, and the positioning columns 27 are fixedly clamped with the positioning holes 26 and the clamping grooves, so that the driving motor 6 drives the rotating disc 5 to rotate and simultaneously drives the bottle body 21 to rotate together, and further centrifugal operation is performed.

The driving end of the driving cylinder 23 is mounted on the top inner side wall of the first operation chamber 12, the driving end of the driving cylinder is provided with a rotating frame 28, the top of the bottle cap 22 of the bottle body 21 is provided with a rotating groove, and the bottom of the rotating frame 28 is rotationally connected with the rotating groove. The driving cylinder 23 is arranged to facilitate the opening of the bottle cap 22, and to improve the stability of the bottle body 21 and the bottle cap 22 in the rotation process, thereby avoiding accidents.

The suction filter assembly 3 as shown in fig. 3 to 6 comprises a suction filter bottle and a first pump body 36; wherein the suction bottle comprises a suction bottle body 31, a filter frame 32 and an end cover 33; the suction filtration bottle body 31 is arranged in a conical shape; the filter frame 32 is arranged at the top of the suction bottle body 31, a filter plate 34 is arranged in the filter frame, and when the suction bottle is in use, filter paper is placed on the filter plate 34; the end cover 33 is mounted on the top of the filter frame 32, the filter frame 32 is in threaded connection with the filter flask body 31, the end cover 33 is in threaded connection with the filter frame 32, and the filter flask body 31 is communicated with the end cover 33 and the filter frame 32.

In addition, the terminal 35 is rotatably connected to the inner side wall of the top liquid inlet of the end cover 33, the top part of the terminal 35 and the top part of the terminal are inserted into the mounting hole of the contact switch 25, in an initial state, the terminal 35 is not in contact with the contact switch 25, and when the centrifugal operation is completed, the driving assembly 4 drives the suction filtration assembly 3 to move integrally so that the terminal 35 is in contact with the contact switch 25 to be electrified, and then the electromagnetic valve 24 is opened. The terminal 35 is supplied with power by a battery.

The first pump body 36 is communicated with the filter frame 32 through an exhaust pipe, and the first pump body 36 is a vacuum pump for vacuumizing and performing suction filtration.

In addition, the suction filtration assembly 3 further comprises a second pump body 37 and a waste liquid collecting box 38, the second pump body 37 is a water suction pump, the water inlet end of the second pump body 37 is communicated with the liquid outlet of the suction filtration bottle body 31 through a water inlet pipeline, the water outlet end of the second pump body 37 is communicated with the waste liquid collecting box 38 through a water outlet pipeline, and the second pump body 37 is used for sucking and collecting waste liquid in the suction filtration bottle body 31 so as to perform centralized treatment on the waste liquid.

The driving assembly 4 comprises a hydraulic cylinder 41 and a jacking bracket 42, the driving end of the hydraulic cylinder 41 is installed at the bottom of the second operation chamber 13, the jacking bracket 42 is installed at the end part of the driving end of the hydraulic cylinder 41, a mounting hole is formed in the top of the jacking bracket 42, and the suction bottle body 31 is detachably installed in the mounting hole in a fastening and fixing mode; the first pump body 36, the second pump body 37 and the waste liquid collection tank 38 are all mounted on the jacking bracket 42.

Specifically, in this embodiment, an electronic control unit (not shown) is further disposed in the cabinet body 1, so as to control each component to work.

The working principle of the invention is as follows:

When the centrifugal bottle is used, firstly, the switch of the driving air cylinder 23 is started to drive the bottle cap 22 on the bottle body 21 to move upwards, then the solution to be centrifuged is poured into the bottle body 21, the driving air cylinder 23 is started to lock the bottle cap 22 on the top of the bottle body 21, and the fixed rotating frame 28 is enabled to rotate the disc 5 to drive the bottle body 21 to perform centrifugal operation.

After the centrifugal operation is completed, the bottle cap 22 of the bottle body 21 is opened, the supernatant is taken out, the electromagnetic valve 2424 contacts with the switch to open the electromagnetic valve 24, after the suction filtration operation of the suction filtration bottle body 31 in the bottle body 21 is completed, the hydraulic cylinder 41 is started to drive the suction filtration assembly 3 to move downwards as a whole, the binding post 35 is disconnected with the contact switch 25, the electromagnetic valve 24 is closed, then the end cover 33 on the filter frame 32 is opened, and the filter paper is taken out.

After taking out the filter paper, a new filter paper is put in, and the end cap 33 is covered.

Standard parts used in the invention can be purchased from the market, special-shaped parts can be customized according to the description of the specification and the drawings, the specific connection modes of all parts adopt conventional means such as mature bolts, rivets and welding in the prior art, the machinery, the parts and the equipment adopt conventional modes in the prior art, and the circuit connection adopts conventional connection modes in the prior art, so that details are not described in detail in the specification, and the invention belongs to the prior art known to the person skilled in the art.

Various modifications to these embodiments will be readily apparent to those skilled in the art, and the generic principles defined herein may be applied to other embodiments without departing from the spirit or scope of the invention.
